Texts are copied verbatim from Lody's product cards (data/assets/product-cards) and allergen chart (data/source/allergen-chart-2026-09-26.csv).

products.title: Phillips Chocolate Dark Chocolate Bar
products.shortDescription: Rich, smooth dark chocolate bar made with high-quality cocoa.

products.title: Phillips Chocolate Milk Chocolate Bar
products.shortDescription: Creamy milk chocolate bar with a smooth and rich texture.

products.title: Phillips Chocolate S'mores Bar
products.shortDescription: A rich chocolate bar layered with gooey marshmallow cream and crunchy graham cracker pieces.

products.title: Phillips Chocolate Princess Assortment Box
products.shortDescription: A beautiful assortment of handmade Phillips chocolates.
products.description: A beautiful assortment of handmade Phillips chocolates featuring a delicious variety of creamy milk chocolate, rich dark chocolate, caramel-filled favorites, nutty turtles, and assorted chocolate-covered confections. Each piece offers its own irresistible combination of smooth, rich, and crunchy flavors perfect for gifting or enjoying yourself.

products.title: Milk Chocolate Covered Raisins
products.shortDescription: Raisins generously coated in smooth, creamy milk chocolate for the perfect balance of rich sweetness and fruity goodness.

products.title: Chocolate Covered Gummy Bears
products.shortDescription: A bold twist on a classic favorite—these Chocolate Covered Gummy Bears take soft, fruity gummies and wrap them in a smooth, velvety layer of rich chocolate for the ultimate indulgence.

products.title: Phillips Chocolate Covered Turtle Fudge
products.shortDescription: Rich, creamy fudge packed with the irresistible flavors of a classic turtle.
products.description: Rich, creamy fudge packed with the irresistible flavors of a classic turtle—smooth chocolate, buttery caramel, and crunchy pecans, all finished with a decadent chocolate coating. A rich and indulgent treat in every bite.

products.title: Turtles 9pc Assortment Box
products.shortDescription: A decadent assortment of 9 classic chocolate turtles.
products.description: A decadent assortment of 9 classic chocolate turtles, featuring three irresistible varieties: 3 milk chocolate cashew turtles, 3 dark chocolate almond turtles, and 3 milk chocolate pecan turtles. Each one combines buttery caramel, crunchy roasted nuts, and smooth, luxurious chocolate for the perfect balance of rich, nutty, and melt-in-your-mouth goodness. Beautifully packaged and ready to gift—or enjoy all to yourself.

products.title: Peanut Butter Bark
products.shortDescription: Indulge in the perfect balance of sweet, salty, and crunchy with Phillips Peanut Butter Bark.
products.description: Indulge in the perfect balance of sweet, salty, and crunchy with Phillips Peanut Butter Bark. Each pack includes two generous pieces of milk chocolate bark layered with a rich, crunchy chocolate peanut butter filling.

products.title: Sea Salt Chocolate Caramels (9 pc)
products.shortDescription: A delicious assortment of 9 handcrafted sea salt caramels.
products.description: A delicious assortment of 9 handcrafted sea salt caramels—featuring 5 pieces of smooth milk chocolate and 4 pieces of rich dark chocolate. Each buttery, melt-in-your-mouth caramel is coated in luxurious chocolate and finished with a delicate sprinkle of sea salt. Beautifully presented in a classic window box, it's an irresistible treat for gifting or indulging yourself.

products.title: Swedish Candy Bag
products.shortDescription: Swedish Candy Mix with Bubs (8 oz).
products.description: This mix is packed with soft, pillowy gummies and foamy, melt-in-your mouth bites, delivering the perfect balance of sweet, tangy, and fruity flavors in every handful.

products.title: 10 Pieces Mini Pancakes
products.shortDescription: Fluffy, golden-bite mini pancakes stacked to perfection—10 pieces of pure comfort in every order.
products.description: Fluffy, golden-bite mini pancakes stacked to perfection—10 pieces of pure comfort in every order. Each mini pancake is light, soft, and freshly made, then generously topped with a cloud of airy whipped cream. To finish, we drizzle our rich, homemade warm chocolate fudge over the top, melting slightly into every layer for that perfect sweet bite.
